verdicts.reason: The two are almost identical. Both put the 'WEEKEND ONLY' kicker hard against the top edge. Both set the body copy so large that it competes with the '20% off' headline. Both shrink the legal line to illegible micro-type, and both make the product a tiny cut-off can inside a cramped circle. B's slightly bigger 'Shop Sale' button leaves the legal text almost touching its bottom edge. A keeps a little more breathing room there, so it edges ahead by a hair.
